_comment: FFU Builder Version Configuration - Single source of truth for all versioning

versioningPolicy.majorBump: Breaking changes to configs/scripts OR major milestones
versioningPolicy.minorBump: New user-facing features OR significant improvements
versioningPolicy.patchBump: Bug fixes OR any subcomponent version change

FFU.Common.description: BUG-WINGET-01: Winget CLI -AllUsers install for elevated context visibility

FFU.Common.Logging.description: Structured logging with levels, JSON output, session correlation

FFUUI.Core.description: Phase 50: Selective Rebuild Pipeline - disposition ComboBox (Reuse/Rebuild/Skip) per artifact tier, 4-status scanner rendering (Found/Degraded/Error/Missing), Disposition config round-trip, Build-UIConfiguration pipeline integration

FFU.Core.description: DISM readiness check (DISM-HEALTH-01) - Test-DismReady WIMMount validation, Clear-OrphanedMountPointsWithoutDism non-DISM fallback

FFU.ADK.description: Windows ADK validation and installation, background job compatible output

FFU.Apps.description: Smart Apps.iso staleness detection (Test-AppsISOStaleness) - Three-tier detection: ISO existence, config comparison, file hash comparison

FFU.Drivers.description: Phase 38 PATH-01: SUBST driver injection loop - Invoke-DismDriverInjectionWithSubstLoop with INF scanning, deduplication, path walk-up, sequential SUBST map->inject->unmap

FFU.Imaging.description: Phase 38 PATH-01: SUBST integration - New-FFU uses Invoke-DismDriverInjectionWithSubstLoop for MAX_PATH safety with backward-compatible fallback

FFU.Media.description: ISO disk space pre-validation (REL-MED-03) - Test-ISOCreationReadiness estimates ISO size from WinPE folder, validates output destination space before oscdimg

FFU.Updates.description: DISM resilience (Phase 44-01) - Test-DismReady gates before all Add-WindowsPackage calls, fast-fail on WIMMount failure, eliminates 30+ min hangs

FFU.VM.description: Checkpoint-aware selective cleanup - Get-FFUEnvironment preserves checkpoint artifacts during resume

FFU.Messaging.description: Thread-safe messaging for UI/background job communication

FFU.Preflight.description: Capture disk space pre-flight (CAP-DISK-01) - Test-FFUCaptureDiskSpace validates FFU capture location has sufficient free space before VM launch

FFU.Hypervisor.description: Service recovery (REL-HYP-04), Test-HypervisorService, Invoke-WithHypervisorRetry, automatic retry on service interruptions

FFU.BuildTest.description: Build testing and verification with elevated execution support (Start-FFUBuildListener, Invoke-FFUBuildElevated)

FFU.ConfigMigration.description: Configuration file migration and schema versioning, ThreadJob compatible ($function: instead of Get-Command)

FFU.ArtifactScanner.description: Phase 46: Artifact discovery, validation, and cross-compatibility checking for USB Mode. Data contract (ArtifactManifest, ArtifactResult, FFUMetadata) for Phase 47-49.
